patches.title: Compile the RGA pointer names in the portable guest
patches.reason: The beta 21 beam accessor serializes the four conflict2 pointers with getregfrompt and restores them with getptfromreg, but both helpers remained inside the P6_STATE_BODIES guard. Waterbox intentionally compiles P6_PORTABLE without the native state bodies, so custom.cpp failed before link. Keep only the two pure pointer-name helpers available to that profile and leave every save/restore body excluded.

patches.title: Reanchor host time before beta21 resets the cycle counter
patches.reason: WinUAE 6.1 beta 21 added an early set_cycles(start_cycles) while the portable hook inherited from patch 0073 remained immediately before a later, now redundant set_cycles. A reset therefore moved the engine counter backwards before the bridge could account elapsed ticks and reanchor the deterministic RTC, faulting the image at the unit boundary. Move only the existing hook before the first counter reset; keep both upstream set_cycles calls and the clock's backwards-time check.

patches.title: Floppy controller state: the scale of the head position
patches.reason: T57: updatemfmpos scales the position of the head by the ratio of the new track length to the last one the position was scaled to (prevtracklen), which is 0 right after an insert and otherwise the length of the last filled track. restore_disk copies it from the LIVE machine's track, so a state taken on one raw track and loaded in a machine that had last scaled to another (every track of an extended ADF or FDI has its own length) moved the head by the wrong ratio when it left the track. DSKX carries it as the tenth word of each drive.
patches.test: tests/state/test_det02_trackdisk.py (the seek ring over raw tracks of six different lengths)

patches.title: A raw track leaves no stale bits in its last word
patches.reason: T57: a raw track of the extended ADF reads (bitlen + 7) / 8 bytes into the MFM buffer and then builds words from pairs of bytes, so the second byte of the last word of a track whose length is not a multiple of 16 bits was whatever the previous track left. The drive never reads those bits (the position wraps at the length), but the buffer is saved in the state (DSDn), so its bytes have to be a function of the image alone.
patches.test: tests/state/test_det02_trackdisk.py (a raw track of an odd number of bytes)

patches.title: fdi2raw reads a hostile FDI without leaving its buffers
patches.reason: T57b: fdi2raw.cpp trusts the file: the Huffman streams of a low-level track are read with no end (the tree recurses as deep as the stream says, root is an uninitialised node that a leaf frees), a pulse count of 2^32 allocates and indexes, a zero-width cell loops for ever, the bits out are written past the 40000-byte buffer, the cells are timed by a division by zero and a double cast out of range, a track with no index stream walks it with offsets that were never set, the cache keeps every decoded track (a megabyte each) and loadtrack indexes the cache before it flips the side. Everything the decoder takes from the file is now checked against the bytes of the track and against fixed limits (262144 pulses, tree depth 40, 70000 nodes, 8 sub-streams, 200000 bits out, 4*pulses+64 steps), the source buffer is the size of the largest track plus 4 KiB of zeros, and the cache keeps one track; a track it cannot decode is an unformatted one.
patches.test: tests/media/test_fdi.py (low-level tracks with and without an index stream) and the trackdisk fuzz target with FDI seeds

patches.title: fdi2raw draws its weak bits from the track and the revolution, not from the machine
patches.reason: T57b: the pulses of a low-level FDI track are drawn at random (a pulse with a stability below the largest is there with that probability, the stable ones jitter within their bounds) with the emulator's generator uaerand. A decode then changed the machine's future by the number of draws it made, and the buffer that a state restore decodes again was not the one the original had decoded earlier. The draws are a function of (track, revolution) with a generator of the decoder's own (xorshift32, seeded by a mix of both); fdi2raw_set_revolution gives the revolution that disk.cpp counts and the state carries.

patches.title: FDI tracks are a function of the revolution, and the state carries the multi-revolution reader
patches.reason: T57b: drive_fill_bigbuf passes the revolution (fdirev, counted from 0 whenever the head reads another track, fditrack) to fdi2raw and makes the length 0 before the call, so a track the decoder cannot read is an unformatted one and not the previous track's length; fetchnextrevolution counts the next revolution and keeps the old length when the new one cannot be decoded. DSKX carries, for each drive, multi_revolution (DSDn restores the buffer but not the flag that says it has several revolutions), revolution_check, fdirev and fditrack: 46 to 62 words.
patches.test: tests/state/test_det02_trackdisk.py (an FDI whose track has weak bits, read for more than a turn)

patches.title: The timing of a buffered track is one value per byte in the state
patches.reason: T57b: DISK_update reads the timing of a track (FDI, IPF) as tracktiming[mfmpos / 8], one value per byte of the track, and upstream's save_disk2/restore_disk2 write one per 16-bit word: the second half of the timing array was never carried, and a machine that loaded the state read that half of the track at the speed the buffer left there (the first revolution's, after an insert). DSDn with the timing bit now holds the words and then (tracklen + 7) / 8 values.
patches.test: tests/state/test_det02_trackdisk.py (FDI with weak pulses in the whole track)

patches.title: disk.cpp reads an IPF through the free reader (ipf_track.h): insert, a track, the next revolution, close
patches.reason: T58b: ADF_IPF was the capsimg hook (caps_loadimage, caps_loadtrack, caps_loadrevolution) and is not compiled. With P6_IPF the drive keeps the index of the image (opened at insert from the store of media, closed at eject), decodes the track under the head with the revolution it is, which counts from 0 whenever another track is read and is the fdirev/fditrack of the FDI in DSKX, and fetches the next revolution of a track with weak cells at every index. Nothing is added to the state: the reader keeps nothing between two reads, the buffer and its timing are in DSDn and the index is made again when the state's medium is inserted.

patches.title: Preserve the serialized blitter channel mask across BLTCON derived-state rebuild
patches.reason: T58: Amiga Soccer exposes BLTX blit_ch 13 changing to 9 at load. restore_blitter_new reads the pipeline mask but blit_bltset derives it from a BLTCON0 write that is still pending. Keep the serialized mask while rebuilding other derived values; synthetic pending-bltcon and frontend byte-for-byte round trips cover this without game bytes.

patches.title: Check the unmodified nearest-sprite sentinel before scaling an AGA countdown
patches.reason: T35d: min starts at INT_MAX when no armed sprite lies in the future. Testing min-2 against INT_MAX always succeeds; SuperHires then shifts INT_MAX-2 beyond unsigned-int range. Test min itself so the sentinel stays unscaled. Real distances and the -2 matching margin are unchanged; the derived count is rebuilt and is not serialized.
patches.test: tests/step/test_sprite_nearest.py; tests/step/test_aga.py; T35c frontend resolution corpus

patches.title: Expose upstream 68000 normal and prefetch-compatible execution
patches.reason: T53 first vertical rebased on beta21: choose the existing generic/prefetch/CE tables, accessors and loops by restart configuration. Returning compatible loop handlers have their own correctly typed table; beta21's 0..7 lastipl range is preserved outside CE and the CE generator output stays unchanged. MMU-only opcode debugging remains excluded.

patches.title: Apply CD32 pad levels at the common unit boundary and expose its serial protocol state
patches.reason: T70 CD32 vertical rebased on beta21: preserve both pad shifters and CIA clock edges in native state; no host polling, mapping reconfiguration or second scheduler. The unchanged engine patch moves only with beta21's inputdevice.cpp layout.

patches.title: Select upstream normal and compatible cores for the 68010 and 68020
patches.reason: T53 beta21 vertical: extend the three accuracy levels to every supported CPU while retaining beta21's accessors and loops. The restricted generator starts its generic family at the requested 68020 model, so it emits 020/010/000 handlers without 030/040/060 cache dependencies; input record/playback debugging remains excluded. Beta21 also retains lastipl in the exact 68020 interrupt path, so that model may carry the bounded edge state at an instruction boundary.

patches.title: Expose the RF5C01A controls, alarm registers and battery RAM for native state
patches.reason: T55a beta21 vertical: semantic copies preserve every reachable RF5C01A register while the calendar remains on the deterministic clock service. The accessors append after beta21's existing CIA state hooks; no A4000 preset, host battery file or wall clock is enabled.

patches.title: Apply the second mouse at the video boundary
patches.reason: T70b beta21 vertical: an independent second pointer uses the existing per-port counters, deltas and buttons without rebuilding host mappings. Its mode is derived from the applied device on restore, preserving the existing P6IN body and bound.

patches.title: Reject portable PMMU opcodes without fake MMU state
patches.reason: T53 beta21 vertical: 0344 already starts the restricted generic file at 68020 and emits only the supported 020/010/000 family. Exclude the remaining newcpu fake-MMU helpers from P6_PORTABLE so the generated table's real line-F handler rejects PMMU without linking or mutating fictitious translation state.

patches.title: Restore the real A4000 motherboard and normal no-MMU 68030
patches.reason: T55b beta21 vertical: enable real Fat Gary/Ramsey, physical A4000 IDE and CPU030 while retaining beta21 memory behavior. The explicit generator profile rejects PMMU through line-F and unrestricted generation stays upstream-identical; PCMCIA, MMU and host services remain excluded.

patches.title: Apply an absolute optical sensor at the boundary and expose its hardware latch
patches.reason: T70c beta21 vertical: feed normalized optical input without host MMIO callbacks or drawing-dependent conversions. The photodiode event remains in the emulated scheduler and its beam latch is explicit causal state.

patches.title: Disable bitplane collisions below Full collision level
patches.reason: T77a beta21 vertical: None otherwise leaks CLXDAT bit 0 because zeroed comparison masks match pixel zero. Gate the bitplane table on Full; Full keeps every previous hardware collision.

patches.title: Expose the real parallel joystick adapter at the frame boundary
patches.reason: T70d beta21 vertical drives the real CIA parallel-adapter levels without host parallel services, preserving serial output and causal state. The portable CIA-B branch runs only while the adapter is attached.

patches.title: Generate 040/060 instruction tables without MMU and retain real cache maintenance
patches.reason: T55c1 beta21 vertical prepares normal 040/060 handlers without exposing models. PMMU opcodes and MOVEC translation controls are rejected in the no-MMU profile; real cache pushes and invalidations remain active while unavailable MMU maintenance is excluded.

patches.title: Expose the real 24C08 protocol and memory as a private semantic state
patches.reason: T66c beta21 vertical reuses the real WinUAE EEPROM without host backing. All causal I2C fields and chip memory are validated before replacement; fixed geometry and bindings are derived.

patches.title: Encode the ECMA-130 Mode1 synchronization field exactly
patches.reason: T66b beta21 vertical follows ECMA-130 section 14.1: 00, ten FF bytes and 00. The former eleven FF bytes changed the synchronization field and the EDC/ECC computed from it; only the pinned pure encoder is used by the CD probe.

patches.title: Restore the physical Z3 board mapping and shared autoconfig window
patches.reason: T55c2 beta21 vertical keeps one real Z3 board unmapped until guest autoconfig and restores its chosen base plus the Z2/Z3 chain window without host pointers.

patches.title: Keep only the supported 16 MiB Z3 board in the portable profile
patches.reason: T55c2 beta21 vertical preserves only board 0 on the 32-bit 68030 at the size accepted by the bridge; every other Z3 configuration remains excluded.

patches.title: Isolate pinned CUE parsing through bounded metadata callbacks
patches.reason: T66e2a shares parsecue directive/token traversal while the metadata-only branch excludes the image device and codecs. Relative indices, flags and all gaps remain explicit for normalization in T66e2b.

patches.title: Export bounded CCD metadata through the pinned parseccd traversal
patches.reason: T66j1 isolates the real CCD section traversal, validates numeric/TOC/index consistency and retains raw Q fields, without opening IMG/SUB or enabling a CD device.

patches.title: Service Akiko CD requests cooperatively at emulated hsync boundaries
patches.reason: T95cp rebases the bounded hsync service on beta21 while preserving complete FIFO play packets, admission backpressure, 128-sector buffers and explicit unsupported CDDA.

patches.title: Pause and capture the real CDA stream without host time
patches.reason: T95cq ports the bounded single-stream CDA state to beta21: pause preserves cursor and deadline, restore derives pointers and callbacks, and foreign streams remain rejected.

patches.title: Anchor Akiko service phases to integer emulated cycles and real reset
patches.reason: T95cr ports the PAL/NTSC cycle accumulators to beta21: turbo cannot accelerate hardware, zero elapsed cycles do no work, and reset anchors phase and clears pending commands.

patches.title: Export bounded DAO NRG metadata through pinned parsenrg
patches.reason: T95cs reuses the pinned chunk traversal on beta21 with bounded offset reads, correct DAOI/CUES layouts and strict single-session DAO validation; no payload or device is opened.

patches.title: Bound portable CD32 FMV hooks and stock ROM policy
patches.reason: T95da rebases the cumulative portable guards on beta21: host semaphore/render hooks stay excluded, stock 68EC020 needs no accelerator ROM patch, and fixed FMV buffers reject invalid dimensions and depths before copy.

patches.title: Own Akiko NVRAM per session and preserve bytes across reset
patches.reason: T66m1 excludes flashfile host access, recreates the real 24C08 protocol over persistent session bytes, and frees the owner only at the registered session exit. Private snapshots include every chip field and the real DDR/pin latches, with transactional validation.

patches.title: Expose pure CDA restore preflight for private aggregate state
patches.reason: T95dc validates the complete player before restoring the real stream; the shared predicate preserves I1 geometry, ownership and causal validation without advancing audio.

patches.title: Capture and restore private Akiko transport without host state
patches.reason: T95dd preserves FIFO cursors, sector caches and subcode causally; unreadable payload is canonical zero while all validity metadata survives. Private preflight rejects invalid states before mutation, without device I/O or time advance.

patches.title: Preserve private Akiko controller and NVRAM causal state
patches.reason: T95de captures explicit controller/TOC/Q/C2P/clock state and extracts pure EEPROM/NVRAM preflights. Applying a valid component does not reopen a disc, execute a command, allocate, notify or advance; transport and backend are aggregated separately.

patches.title: Load canonical stock CD32 extended and main firmware in portable memory
patches.reason: T95df opens only the private stock CD32 profile to the canonical one-MiB pair; both halves use exact checked read_kickstart and retain the CD32 E0/F8 maps. Other profiles keep their closed ROM envelope.

patches.title: Aggregate private Akiko state with owner-independent validation
patches.reason: T95dg validates controller, transport and CD backend/player by value before a transactional apply to an initialized destination. It preserves cold DMA mapping and exact RX/TX, subcode, EEPROM/C2P and PCM continuation without I/O, callbacks, allocation or time advance.

patches.title: Restore CDA clock update in the portable device graph
patches.reason: T95dh restores the emulated CDA clock notification in the real portable device graph. Portable startup computes frame clocks while produce_sound can still be zero, before the PCM transport opens; update_sound safely ignores that unopened transport.

patches.title: Preserve Paula phase with an explicitly owned CDA stream
patches.reason: T95di shares phase capture/application with the strict native endpoint while permitting only no extra stream or the backend-owned slot0 stereo CDA stream. It restores values without clock advancement or stream scheduling.

patches.title: Preserve CD32 one-shot overlay latch during native CIA restore
patches.reason: T95dj carries oldovl only for the private CD32 auto-overlay profile; existing CIA-overlay profiles still derive OVL from PRA/DDRA with their unchanged body. Unsupported auto-overlay profiles remain rejected.

patches.title: Capture and restore private internal 040/060 SoftFloat state
patches.reason: T95dk preserves every FSAVE word and pending FPU state with pure context validation before transactional application; it does not expose models, change P6CP or implement the upstream FRESTORE040 TODO.

patches.title: Allow all bounded Z3 RAM capacities in the portable profile
patches.reason: T95dl extends the single A4030 physical Z3 board to the reference capacities 1..512 MiB without enabling other CPUs, 24-bit maps or extra boards.

patches.title: Reset registered portable devices without an expansion chain
patches.reason: T95dm stock CD32 has no Fast/HDF/IDE chain: reset callbacks marked pending by devices_reset must run before CPU prefetch resumes, as expamem_reset does for expansion machines.

patches.title: Expose the active CD32 EEPROM backing for frontend persistence
patches.reason: T95ek exposes the same bounded 1024-byte owner used by the real I2C chip; public SaveRAM/frontends remain outside this preparation.

patches.title: Restore defined UNIMP040 fields and pending arithmetic exception
patches.reason: T95dn replaces the FRESTORE040 frame-size skip with real bus reads of the defined fields and E3/E1 arithmetic priority. Null/idle clear stale pending exceptions. Busy pipeline resumption remains outside this correction.

patches.title: Preserve BUSY040 fields and service pending arithmetic before CU
patches.reason: T95do stages the full BUSY frame, retains defined pipeline metadata through private state and FSAVE, and prevents premature CU execution with pending E3/E1. Full pipeline continuation remains outside this correction.

patches.title: Use restored CU address for a newly generated arithmetic exception
patches.reason: T95dp keeps the restored BUSY instruction identity distinct from the following CPU retry PC when CU resumption generates a new arithmetic exception.

patches.title: Resume the FPSP rev40 CU06 extended-register reconstruction
patches.reason: T95dq rebuilds rev40 CU06 from the live architectural destination and IEEE extended ETEMP while leaving other CU06 formats and pipeline states outside this correction.

patches.title: Encode FSQRT state commands and distinguish sqrt from double move
patches.reason: T95dr encodes FSQRT04 as05/21, treats all SQRT precisions as WB/E3 and leaves FDMOVE44 in CU/E1 while preserving other arithmetic-family classification.

patches.title: Retain the physical Z3 board on Normal no-MMU 040 and 060
patches.reason: T95ds opens the native A4040 profile to the same validated physical Z3 board as A4030 on Normal 040/060, without enabling MMU or frontend selectors.

patches.title: Reconstruct sprite state words without signed extension
patches.reason: T95dt ports the attributed 0382 correction to beta21: uint16 sprite words must be widened unsigned before shifts used to rebuild the native 64-bit Denise state.

patches.title: Retain generated integer F-line handlers on 040 and 060
patches.reason: T95dv preserves generated CPU and privilege checks for cache maintenance, MOVE16 and LPSTOP without enabling absent PMMU or FPU handlers.

patches.title: Publish reset registers before FMODE can reapply their saved values
patches.reason: T95dw prevents FMODE(0) from reapplying stale BPLCON0/3/4 and DIWHIGH values in a new AGA session; the eight assignments move together without changing warm-reset policy.

patches.title: Resume FPSP CU06 double commands reconstructed from normal single sources
patches.reason: T95dx decodes only the documented rev40 CU06 normal-SINGLE shape retained by FPSP op2_xi/op2_com, using live FPn and preserving exception priority; double-native and special/denormal variants remain pending.

patches.title: Decode FPSP CU06 reconstructed single zero and infinity
patches.reason: T95dy decodes only FPSP op2_com zero/infinity sentinels with their STAG and sign, preserving E3 priority and enabled DZ/OPERR destinations; NaNs, denormals and native double remain pending.

patches.title: Export bounded MDS v1 metadata without handles or payload reads
patches.reason: T95dz preserves the pinned parsemds layout with explicit endian, bounded reads and raw TOC/geometry/name fields; it neither resolves files nor claims public MDS loading.

patches.title: Export NRG DAO Mode2 2336-byte track metadata
patches.reason: T95ea retains exact physical stride and offsets for DAO mode03 metadata; sector reconstruction and all public providers remain outside this patch.

patches.title: Invalidate pending Akiko deliveries when explicit media presence changes
patches.reason: T66u1: keep the immutable Disc and opened unit while changing media presence, stop CDDA and discard old requests/caches/subchannels at a quiescent boundary. Normal emulated handling owns notification and IRQ timing; preserve response FIFO, CPU, clock and undocumented door bit.

patches.title: Export NRG Mode02 metadata and encode Mode2 Form1 EDC/P/Q
patches.reason: T95eb preserves cooked 2048-byte payload and exposes the existing WinUAE EDC/P/Q implementation through a Form1 wrapper, with the header zeroed only during ECC and then restored; no provider, TAO or multisession support is claimed.

patches.title: Read packed ETNF tracks with explicit canonical 150-sector pregaps
patches.reason: T95ec: GNU VCDImager strips pregaps from ETNF offsets; GNU libcdio reconstructs 150 sectors per preceding track. Expose this explicit policy only for contiguous single-session metadata; original nonstandard pregaps, ETN2 and multisession remain unsupported.

patches.title: Decode FPSP reconstructed CU06 NaN SINGLE payloads
patches.reason: T95ed decodes only FPSP op2_xi/op2_com SINGLE NaN shapes with STAG3, preserving sign, payload and quiet/signaling semantics; native DOUBLE06 and denormals remain pending.

patches.title: Port pinned HRTMon owner and lifecycle through original Action Replay hooks
patches.reason: T69a: private raw pinned GPL HRTMon through copied blob asset, no built-in gzip dependency or host FS. Exclude RTG calls and validate reads/allocation, reset monitor flags/shadows across sessions. Native state is explicitly unsupported until complete cartridge codec. Legacy .uss path codecs are excluded in portable; no successful stubs or path deserialization.

patches.title: Encode Mode2 Form2 EDC without modifying payload or adding P/Q
patches.reason: T95ee exposes the pinned Form2 EDC helper over caller-supplied header, subheader and 2324-byte payload; provider selection and public CHD support remain outside this patch.

patches.title: Preserve native HRTMon memory mapping shadows and CPU pending action
patches.reason: T69b: private fixed HRTMon owner accessors and boundary support for complete native state; memory and causal flags restore without paths or serialized pointers. The bridge requires these endpoints; no-cartridge execution remains unchanged. Capture the three actual fixed A1200 bank maps, including Kickstart mirrors A8..B0 before Freeze; restore each span without changing B1..B7.

patches.title: Serve the private stock CDTV controller cooperatively at hsync
patches.reason: T67a: original DMAC/6525 and command protocol over the common CD backend, with bounded FIFO, emulated SEEK delay, synchronous lifecycle and no host threads or file persistence. Public CDTV profile and causal state remain gated.

patches.title: Capture validate and apply the private typed CDTV component
patches.reason: T67b1: explicit value-only CDTV inventory, buffers, cached TOC/Q, NVRAM and shared CD owner state. Validation precedes application; no clock, callbacks or IRQ effects. Full native P6CT remains disabled until T67b2.

patches.title: Load the verified private CDTV extended and main ROM through bounded views
patches.reason: T67c1: fixed ID22 extended256KiB plus ID6 main256KiB, with original extended bank padding and independent bounded views. No public CDTV profile, autoconfig or state claim.

patches.title: Restore original CDTV autoconfig chain and empty unit without host effects
patches.reason: T67c2: retain the original DMAC card and forwarding, capture pending/assigned/shut-up phases, validate candidate phase and destination before mutation, and restore the real empty unit. Native private profile only; public CD boot and Waterbox remain gated.

patches.title: Read compact NRG ETNF tracks with independent physical and logical positions
patches.reason: T95ef follows the pinned libMirage per-track fragment mapping: compact bytes and sectors accumulate independently across mixed strides while canonical150, bounds and contiguity remain explicit.

patches.title: Read bounded single-session NRG ETN2 with 64-bit extents
patches.reason: T95eg preserves ETN2 64-bit byte extents, 32-bit packed sectors and canonical150 gaps with independent compact coordinates; multisession and providers remain outside this patch.

patches.title: Preserve bounded NRG DAO session metadata before enabling its provider
patches.reason: T95eh pairs CUE/DAO/SINF groups by ordinal and preserves explicit session boundaries, global tracks, catalogs and raw hints; the public provider remains disabled for multisession.

patches.title: Bound raw Action Replay cartridge reads and reset private owner latches
patches.reason: T69d1: privately copied AR2/3 blobs use the original loader and banks. Reject incomplete reads and malformed checksum extents before adoption, guard allocation failures and reset AR owner latches on cleanup. Native snapshots remain explicitly unsupported until a full semantic codec exists; no public cartridge compatibility is claimed.

patches.title: Expose complete private AR2/3 native control and bank state
patches.reason: T69d2: semantic cartridge state includes independent map/visibility latches, saved IRQ7 vector, shadows, RAM and pending CIA handler identity. Restore rebuilds existing banks without triggering NMI or I/O. Native CPU boundary admits the supported private AR2/3 pending phases; no public cartridge option or commercial compatibility is implied.

patches.title: Reset retained CDTV display latches only on a new power-on
patches.reason: T67c3d: two long independent owners diverge by1024ticks at169; transplanting the display/Copper state reproduces it, blitter does not. Restore BSS-zero display state before custom_init only on CDTV power-on, preserving warm reset and first-owner behavior.

patches.title: Start the CDTV disk read shifter at its cold BSS phase
patches.reason: T67c3d: DMA remains active without a physical drive. Exact cold622 replay proves the disk phase domain causes the4096tick return difference; scheduler cursor transplant does not. Reset only bitoffset at new CDTV power-on, preserving hardware RESET and state restore.

patches.title: Preserve AR1 wait-PC state and release its always-present banks
patches.reason: T69e1: private AR1 snapshots preserve wait_pop and wait_for_pc with reachable byte/word strobe SPC forms. Cleanup, also called directly by memory_cleanup, removes ROM/RAM banks before freeing the owner; AR2/3 state bodies and the public cartridge ABI remain unchanged.

patches.title: Expose complete private AR1200 monitor state and retire its banks on cleanup
patches.reason: T69f1: explicitly recognize the AR1200 owner geometry and its dummy/cart map shapes, preserving HRTMon mirrors. Cleanup removes all sixteen banks before freeing the private owner, including direct memory_cleanup. The bridge keeps ROM/padding immutable and serializes every writable upper-half byte with independent ROM/model identity.

patches.title: Parse producer-backed global ETNF sessions with an explicit canonical policy
patches.reason: T95ei imports the proven CDI2Nero global-coordinate policy as metadata only; the private multisession provider remains disabled.

patches.title: Preserve FPSP-normalized small operands in 68040 FE continuation
patches.reason: T95ej uses exponent bit14 with E15 so FPSP-normalized small operands survive FE continuation while wrapped extended denormals retain their existing reconstruction.

patches.title: Query CDTV controller-observed absence without advancing hardware
patches.reason: T67d2: libretro retains physical absence until the stock controller sees it. A pure bounded query avoids copying NVRAM or reading MMIO; its result is derived from existing causal fields, with no new scheduler or state.

patches.title: Start a new display owner with clean interlace detection history
patches.reason: T39b: lace reloads retain prevlofs and interlace_seen from the old owner, shifting init_hz and config_changed in units1/2. A temporary read-only-linked real probe isolates prevlofs: identical BEAM reapply and clearing only interlace_seen fail, while clearing field history converges. Restore BSS zero only before custom_init on a new owner, without requesting configuration work. First-owner behavior, RESET and state_load are unchanged; REF01 retains the required bridge lifecycle hook.

patches.title: Connect the bounded CD32 FMV board to the portable expansion and video graph
patches.reason: T43b1 enables WinUAE's real FMV sync, compositor and Zorro II catalog only after the scalar decoder and bounded portable audio owner have been selected. The board still requires an authenticated pre-load ROM owner; stock CD32 without one keeps the previous graph.

patches.title: Use fixed scalar tables and defined bit arithmetic for portable CD32 FMV Layer II audio
patches.reason: T43b1 removes the kjmp2 run-time cos import and the host/ISA-dependent initialization result; T43b2 makes the 24-bit window unsigned so a full input window cannot trigger signed-shift UB. The literal matrix is the version-1.1 formula truncated toward zero and is ordinary captured guest state; non-portable WinUAE keeps its original initialization.

patches.title: Keep FMV and CDDA PCM streams bounded and owner-distinct
patches.reason: T43c lets the 4608-frame FMV block coexist with the existing 588-frame CDDA stream on the same emulated scheduler. Stop, refill and pause validate the exact cd_audio_state owner; forged or stale ids cannot replace another stream, and portable buffers are capped at one FMV block.

patches.title: Record a bounded address-free FMV decoder journal
patches.reason: T43d1 routes portable CL450 input through stable journal-owned bytes and records exact scalar parse results. A sequence-to-I checkpoint permits bounded reconstruction in a fresh decoder without serializing libmpeg2 pointers, raw structs or host timing.

patches.title: Expose the complete CD32 FMV device as bounded value state
patches.reason: T43d2 captures the real CL450, L64111, PCM, video and genlock owners without pointers, reconstructs libmpeg2 from the bounded journal and restores its distinct audio stream only after candidate validation. A fresh image reconstructs the bound cartridge owner and fixed banks without guest execution; the public state registry remains unchanged for stock CD32 images.

patches.title: Bound CD32 FMV software composition before writing output
patches.reason: T43e1 replaces the unchecked row arithmetic with one scalar compositor that validates geometry, depth, stride and capacities before its first write. The portable probe exercises exact MPEG, border and Amiga selection for 16/32-bit layouts and integer scales without adding a clock, allocation or frontend hand-over.

patches.title: Capture live FMV ownership and pre-frame genlock state
patches.reason: T43f2 found with Cannon Fodder that stock CD32 phase capture names the Akiko owner while active FMV PCM belongs to the cartridge, and that genlock can legitimately become active before its first decoded image. Route shared Paula phase through the exact FMV owner, restore inactive-owner gain, preserve this scalar-only genlock phase, and report specific capture failures without weakening candidate validation.

patches.title: Apply a transient presentation gain to the CDDA owner
patches.reason: T84b needs a live frontend CD-audio volume after the hardware CD mixer but before the common Paula/extra-stream mix. Bind the gain to the portable CDDA owner, leave simultaneous FMV untouched, consume samples while muted, and keep the preference outside the semantic CDA state codec.

patches.title: Serve the portable IDE CD through a bounded cooperative ATAPI subset
patches.reason: T84e2 attaches the already authenticated immutable Disc owner to Gayle without the full host SCSI graph. PACKET commands execute synchronously at emulated register boundaries, use the common CDDA clock and return CHECK CONDITION for every unsupported or invalid request.

patches.title: Serialize the portable IDE ATAPI drive semantically
patches.reason: T84e3 restores an IDE CD at command, data and CDDA boundaries without copying ide_hdf or any pointer. The accessor validates ATA/ATAPI cursors, bounded causal buffer, sense and medium identity before applying them to the already-open drive.

patches.title: Bind bounded portable RTG memory to the UAE Zorro III Autoconfig chain
patches.reason: T85f reuses the pinned UAE Z3 RTG identity while replacing host allocation with the static 4 MiB device. The portable profile registers exactly board zero, advertises the required 16 MiB physical aperture with 4 MiB populated, maps only 64 banks after validating the assigned base, and never enables Z2 or physical graphics boards.

patches.title: Bootstrap the bounded uaegfx resident through RTAREA and the filesystem resident list
patches.reason: T85i compiles the portable RTG closure without enabling upstream PICASSO96 or its Win32 backend. T97 additionally proves that filesys_init_storeinfo is a simple trap with no TrapContext, so it cannot call back into Exec to construct uaegfx.card. The DiagArea path now publishes the fixed resident into Exec's ResModules list; AmigaOS performs its normal AUTOINIT after the bounded Z3 bank maps, without a host thread or nested CPU scheduler.

patches.title: Extend semantic Autoconfig state with the bounded RTG bank
patches.reason: T85m appends the mapped base, fixed populated size and map bit only when the portable RTG board is configured. RTG0 keeps the previous expansion body, while restore validates the entire candidate before rebinding the static VRAM bank.

patches.title: Preserve the bounded portable RTG board through preference fixup
patches.reason: T85n configures one UAE Zorro III board without enabling the upstream AUTOCONFIG feature. The portable fixup therefore preserves board zero when P6_PORTABLE_RTG is linked while continuing to erase every unsupported additional RTG slot.

patches.title: Give bounded portable RTG an RTAREA lifecycle without hard files
patches.reason: T85o executes the already linked uaegfx bootstrap without an HDF. RTG therefore shares RTAREA, traps and the filesys resident lifecycle with the HDF owner, while hardfile devices and their worker paths remain conditional on an actual HDF.

patches.title: Preserve quiet CD32 FMV samples through Layer II synthesis
patches.reason: T90 isolates 40-326-sample zero runs inside kjmp2 output while the same real elementary stream has none in the independent FFmpeg decode; changing delivery cadence does not alter them. Retain eight fractional bits across the synthesis matrix and compensate in the window shift, using a 64-bit product to avoid overflow. The total fixed-point scale, decoder clock, PCM ownership and host scheduling remain unchanged.

patches.title: Run uaescsi.device I/O cooperatively in the calling trap
patches.reason: T84g1 exposes only the deterministic CD catalog through uaescsi.device. Portable BeginIO therefore completes ordinary requests synchronously and retains only explicit guest change/frame interrupt requests; no worker, sleep, semaphore, comm pipe, background TrapContext, tape directory or physical SCSI enumeration exists.

patches.title: Expose bounded semantic state for portable uaescsi.device
patches.reason: T84g2 snapshots only guest addresses and value state for the cooperative unit: private opens, change/frame requests with their copied IORequests, change state, geometry and fade controls. Validation is complete before apply; host pointers, thread objects and physical-device state never enter the snapshot.

patches.title: Install the uaescsi.device resident without changing HDF controllers
patches.reason: T84g3 exposes uaescsi.device as an independent deterministic CD transport. Its resident needs RTAREA even when no hard file or RTG board is present; enabling it neither creates a filesystem board nor changes the controller selected for any HDF.

patches.title: Keep 040 MMU control registers architectural without enabling translation
patches.reason: T97 reproduces 80000004, 800A0004 and Line-F 8000000B alerts while an A4000/040 mounts an RDB and starts SysInfo. The UAE boot ROM writes DTT0, the expansion driver reads TC, and SysInfo writes TC=$8000, executes PTESTR and writes URP. Preserve WinUAE's architectural control-register storage and its existing physical PTEST/PFLUSH semantics while compiling out address translation; stored TC/URP/SRP values never select a translation backend in the portable build.

patches.title: Scale the portable normal 68030+ interpreter by its emulated clock
patches.reason: T98 measures identical CIA time at multipliers 2 and 8 on A4030 and A4040 because WinUAE's normal interpreter uses fixed approximate divisors for those CPUs. Preserve the multiplier-2 baseline and scale only CPU instruction work against emulated time; chipset, DMA and audio scheduling remain on the existing event clock.

patches.title: Reject host directory existence probes in the portable profile
patches.reason: WinUAE 6.1 beta21 adds a host-path existence query to filedir_exists. Portable configuration already rejects host directory volumes, so keep the unreachable fallback explicit and return false without importing a host filesystem probe; archive and CDFS paths retain their upstream implementations.

patches.title: Use the renamed beta21 SoftFloat header
patches.reason: The imported beta21 snapshot retained the old 0021 uppercase include, while beta21 renamed the file itself to softfloat-macros.h. Match the real case so case-sensitive hosts and Apple Clang's nonportable-include-path check compile the same source; SoftFloat arithmetic and float_raise linkage remain unchanged.

patches.title: Keep beta21 ARM64 CCR shifts unsigned
patches.reason: WinUAE 6.1 beta21 places native ARM64 NZCV flags at bits 28 through 31 of a 64-bit field, but its setters shift signed int values and SET_NFLG(1) reaches the sign bit. Use the field type for masks and shifted values so all setters are defined and preserve unrelated bits.

patches.title: Keep 68030 PMMU queries architectural without enabling translation
patches.reason: The portable beta21 profile turns every 68030 PMMU opcode into Line-F even though the processor integrates the architectural PMMU registers independently of page-table translation. Retain beta21's fake PMOVE, PTEST, PLOAD and PFLUSH register model while translation stays excluded. On 68040 and 68060 retain generated FPU handlers without a configured unit so the processor builds its specific absent-unit frame instead of a generic illegal opcode.
